$comment: The source of truth for the service marks Basalt bundles for an architecture card (DECISIONS 292, 2.4 and 2.5). One entry a mark. forms names which file draws on light grounds and which on dark ("swapped": the light file with its one fill swapped, as swap says). ink is each form's ink that meets the ground (the contrast test reads it). changes are which of 2.3's three were applied: stripped (what does not draw), fitted (the view box set to the artwork's bounds), swapped. viewBox is the fitted box per form, worked out once by fit.mjs and recorded here, so generating is the same on every machine. A mark is removed by deleting its entry and its source file; nothing else names it. Run node packages/react/marks/generate.mjs after an edit. unofficial: true marks a drawing that is not the owner's own file (DECISIONS 297: the owner asked for a mark on these even where it is not an official logo); its edits list every change made to the fetched file before the pipeline's own, and both files are in source/ with their hashes.

notShipped.why: Every instance icon carries lettering that is dust at 16px. A database card takes aws-database.
Its topic is drawn in dotted rows that vanish at 16px.

departures: Unofficial (DECISIONS 297): BlazeMeter publishes no mark file; this is Simple Icons' drawing, shown black on light grounds and white on dark rather than its red.
The mark is wide: at 16px wide it is about 6px tall. It holds a letter B, which the set's no-lettering rule would exclude; the owner asked for it (DECISIONS 297).
